extraction.notes: Pass 1 full extraction from the converted text file under extraction rules 0.4. Multi-country Communication: only passages about North Macedonia and horizontal passages addressed to all Western Balkan or enlargement partners that fall within Chapter 2 (as bounded in the run record) or the technology and AI theme were extracted. Method: keyword search over the whole file (country name, digital, cyber, AI, e-government, e-services, broadband, roaming, workers, social security, EURES, interoperability, electronic, data protection, connectivity, information society, technology) and full reading of every page with a hit, including the whole North Macedonia summary in Annex 1 (pages 38-41), the North Macedonia conclusions (paragraph 12, pages 23-24) and Annex 2 on the Western Balkans Strategy (pages 55-59). Annex 3 statistical tables (pages 60-66) have no in-scope indicators. Period covered left empty: the register gives none and the Communication states no reporting period. Chapter 2 appears only once (page 41). Cybercrime material (Budapest Convention, Europol EC3) left out under R21 except where joined with ENISA or cybersecurity in the same sentence. Second-pass check done (G3 condition 2), see review/RUN-2026-01/second_pass/.
